title: Generative
description: Terrain generation at it's finest, with a handful of other mods.
body:
![Generative](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/7053f33ba2fda4190b563fe26eacc938de86bc98.png)

Terrain generation like never before!

> **Please ensure that you install the correct version of the modpack. The server version does not contain any client-side mods.**

This mod uses many terrain generation mods and datapacks to make the terrain as beautiful as possible!

This mod primarily uses:
- [Biomes O' Plenty](https://modrinth.com/mod/biomes-o-plenty) by Forstride and Adubbz
- [Middgard](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/middgard) by SbeevYT
- [Terralith](https://modrinth.com/mod/terralith) by Stardust Labs
- [Tectonic](https://modrinth.com/mod/tectonic) by Apollo and DawnKiro

**Contains `106` projects. This includes mods, resourcepacks, datapacks, and shaders.**
